parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the human CB2 receptor in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Cannabinoid CB2 receptor' and assay organism 'Homo sapiens'. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort results by compound_chembl_id.
